answer: A fresh account starts at the nadir of trust, near zero weight, and must earn standing slowly through a refundable stake-bond that unlocks only as independent peers attest to honest work over many epochs. Reputation ripens like fruit in a tended orchard; it cannot be bought with a velvet promise. A clone fleet must sink a separate bond and serve its own vesting window per fake, so sybil cost scales linearly with the number of forged identities.
